main_claim: Topuria says the biggest lesson from his divorce was to listen to his mother, and describes how hard the public split was for him and his children.

The Gaethje loss and 'recovering from facial injuries' are the writer's closing recap, so result and health are no.

main_claim: Punahele Soriano, who meets Donchenko on Saturday's main card in Paris, says he is happiest flying under the radar and calls Donchenko a scary, young opponent.

The booking is the premise of a fight-week feature, so no fact.

main_claim: Topuria tells Joe Rogan he was never a Demetrious Johnson fan because he thought his nickname was 'Mickey Mouse', and Johnson jokes back.

He speaks about Johnson, not about himself, so no listed act fits (a 'speaks of another fighter' value would); an editor could instead take Johnson's jab as other_fighter_side / calls_him_out, or stretch to speaks_of_himself.

The fractures, suspension and 'informaciones' about a year-end return are the writer's recap and speculation, so health and next fight are no.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is fine, positive and enjoying life, resting to come back stronger and beat everyone.
